## Op-amp gain (inverting / non-inverting)

<p class="calc-context">Full derivation: [Op-amp basics](../integrated-circuits/op-amp-basics.qmd).</p>

```{=html}
<div id="calc-opamp-gain"></div>
<script src="../assets/js/calc-engine.js"></script>
<script>
Calc.create({
  root: "calc-opamp-gain",
  inputs: [
    { id: "topology", label: "Topology", type: "select", value: "noninverting", options: [
      { value: "noninverting", label: "Non-inverting" },
      { value: "inverting", label: "Inverting" }
    ] },
    { id: "Rf", label: "Rf (kΩ)", value: 10, min: 0, step: 1 },
    { id: "Rin", label: "Rin (kΩ)", value: 1, min: 0.001, step: 1 }
  ],
  outputs: [
    { id: "gain", label: "Gain (V/V)" },
    { id: "gainDb", label: "Gain (dB)" }
  ],
  compute: function (v) {
    if (v.Rin <= 0) return { gain: "-", gainDb: "-" };
    var gain = v.topology === "noninverting" ? 1 + v.Rf / v.Rin : -(v.Rf / v.Rin);
    var gainDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.abs(gain));
    return { gain: gain.toFixed(3), gainDb: gainDb.toFixed(2) + " dB" };
  }
});
</script>
```

## Ratio to dB / dB to ratio

<p class="calc-context">Full derivation: [Gain and decibels](../integrated-circuits/gain-and-decibels.qmd).</p>

```{=html}
<div id="calc-ratio-to-db"></div>
<script>
Calc.create({
  root: "calc-ratio-to-db",
  inputs: [
    { id: "ratio", label: "Ratio (x times)", value: 11, min: 0.0000001, step: 0.1 },
    { id: "kind", label: "Quantity", type: "select", value: "voltage", options: [
      { value: "voltage", label: "Voltage / current (20log)" },
      { value: "power", label: "Power (10log)" }
    ] }
  ],
  outputs: [ { id: "db", label: "dB" } ],
  compute: function (v) {
    if (v.ratio <= 0) return { db: "-" };
    var mult = v.kind === "power" ? 10 : 20;
    return { db: (mult * Math.log10(v.ratio)).toFixed(2) + " dB" };
  }
});
</script>

<div id="calc-db-to-ratio"></div>
<script>
Calc.create({
  root: "calc-db-to-ratio",
  inputs: [
    { id: "db", label: "dB", value: 20, step: 0.5 },
    { id: "kind", label: "Quantity", type: "select", value: "voltage", options: [
      { value: "voltage", label: "Voltage / current (20log)" },
      { value: "power", label: "Power (10log)" }
    ] }
  ],
  outputs: [ { id: "ratio", label: "Ratio (x times)" } ],
  compute: function (v) {
    var div = v.kind === "power" ? 10 : 20;
    return { ratio: Math.pow(10, v.db / div).toFixed(4) + "×" };
  }
});
</script>
```

## Op-amp closed-loop bandwidth

<p class="calc-context">Full derivation: [Op-amp frequency response](../integrated-circuits/op-amp-frequency-response.qmd).</p>

```{=html}
<div id="calc-gbw"></div>
<script>
Calc.create({
  root: "calc-gbw",
  inputs: [
    { id: "gbw", label: "GBW (MHz)", value: 10, min: 0.001, step: 1 },
    { id: "noiseGain", label: "Noise gain (V/V)", value: 11, min: 1, step: 1 }
  ],
  outputs: [ { id: "bw", label: "Closed-loop -3dB bandwidth" } ],
  compute: function (v) {
    if (v.noiseGain <= 0) return { bw: "-" };
    var bwMHz = v.gbw / v.noiseGain;
    var bwTxt = bwMHz >= 1 ? bwMHz.toFixed(3) + " MHz" : (bwMHz * 1000).toFixed(1) + " kHz";
    return { bw: bwTxt };
  }
});
</script>
```
